name: MonarchEntityPicker
title: EntityPicker
wrapsNative: Button field that presents a .sheet with a NavigationStack, a List of Buttons with MonarchAvatar and .searchable(text:placement:prompt:); a debounced search runs in .task(id:)
summary: A field for picking one or several people or records from a list that can be searched on the app's server, shown with avatars, in a sheet.
whenToUse: For an owner, an assignee, reviewers, a company or a project, where people recognise the entity by its name and picture and the list may be too long to load at once.
whenNotToUse: Not for plain text values (use MonarchCombobox), not for several plain values (use MonarchMultiSelect), and not for a few fixed choices (use Picker).
api: init(_ label: String, selection: Binding<String?>, entities: [MonarchEntityPickerEntity], selectedEntities: [MonarchEntityPickerEntity] = [], prompt: String? = nil, helper: String? = nil, error: String? = nil, clearOptionTitle: String? = nil, isRequired: Bool = false, isLoading: Bool = false, minSearchLength: Int = 0, debounce: Duration = .milliseconds(250), labels: MonarchEntityPickerLabels = MonarchEntityPickerLabels(), search: (@Sendable (String) async throws -> [MonarchEntityPickerEntity])? = nil, onCreate: (@MainActor (String) async -> MonarchEntityPickerEntity?)? = nil)

init(_ label: String, selection: Binding<[String]>, entities: [MonarchEntityPickerEntity], selectedEntities: [MonarchEntityPickerEntity] = [], prompt: String? = nil, helper: String? = nil, error: String? = nil, isRequired: Bool = false, isLoading: Bool = false, minSearchLength: Int = 0, debounce: Duration = .milliseconds(250), labels: MonarchEntityPickerLabels = MonarchEntityPickerLabels(), search: (@Sendable (String) async throws -> [MonarchEntityPickerEntity])? = nil, onCreate: (@MainActor (String) async -> MonarchEntityPickerEntity?)? = nil)

struct MonarchEntityPickerEntity: Identifiable, Sendable { init(id: String, name: String, description: String? = nil, hint: String? = nil, image: Image?, systemImage: String? = nil, shape: MonarchAvatarShape = .circle, keywords: String? = nil, isDisabled: Bool = false, group: String? = nil, status: MonarchPresenceStatus? = nil, statusLabel: String? = nil); init(id: String, name: String, description: String? = nil, hint: String? = nil, url: URL? = nil, systemImage: String? = nil, shape: MonarchAvatarShape = .circle, keywords: String? = nil, isDisabled: Bool = false, group: String? = nil, status: MonarchPresenceStatus? = nil, statusLabel: String? = nil) }

struct MonarchEntityPickerLabels: Sendable { init(select: String? = nil, search: String? = nil, cancel: String? = nil, done: String? = nil, loading: String? = nil, empty: String? = nil, tooShort: (@Sendable (Int) -> String)? = nil, failed: String? = nil, create: (@Sendable (String) -> String)? = nil, summary: (@Sendable (String, Int) -> String)? = nil, clear: String? = nil, noSelection: String? = nil, field: MonarchFormFieldLabels = MonarchFormFieldLabels()) }

options.name: label
options.description: The visible label, already localised. It names the field and is the title of the sheet.

options.name: selection
options.description: The chosen id, or the chosen ids in pick order. The array form lets several be picked and keeps the sheet open until Done.

options.name: entities
options.description: The entities to pick from: id, name, description, hint, a picture (image or url), systemImage, shape, keywords, isDisabled, group (a heading) and status (a presence dot). With search, shown until the first search runs.

options.name: selectedEntities
options.description: Entities for chosen ids that may not be in entities, so the field can show their names and pictures.

options.name: prompt
options.description: Shown in the field while nothing is chosen. "Select…" when nil.

options.name: helper
options.description: Help text under the field, also read as the hint.

options.name: error
options.description: An error message, shown with an icon and announced.

options.name: clearOptionTitle
options.description: Single choice only. Adds a first row that clears the selection, such as "Unassigned". Hidden while searching.

options.name: isRequired
options.description: Shows a mark after the label and adds "Required" to the hint.

options.name: isLoading
options.description: Shows a progress row while entities is empty.

options.name: minSearchLength
options.description: The shortest text search runs for. Shorter text shows "Type at least N characters to search."

options.name: debounce
options.description: How long to wait after typing before search runs. A newer text cancels the wait and the older search.

options.name: search
options.description: Loads the entities matching the trimmed text. Throw to show "The results could not be loaded." with Try again. Without it, entities are filtered by name, hint and keywords.

options.name: onCreate
options.description: Offers "Create “text”" when no shown name equals the typed text. The returned entity is chosen; nil chooses nothing.

states.name: empty
states.description: The field shows the prompt in the subtle text colour.

states.name: chosen
states.description: The field shows the avatar and name, or "First +N" for several, and a clear button.

states.name: searching
states.description: The list shows a progress row while the search waits or runs.

states.name: too short
states.description: The list asks for more characters and does not search.

states.name: failed
states.description: The list shows the error with a Try again button that reruns the same text.

states.name: no match
states.description: The list shows "No matches", or the create row when there is a create handler.

states.name: error
states.description: The border takes the danger colour and the message shows under the field with an icon.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Text takes the disabled colours and the field does nothing. A disabled entity's row is dimmed and cannot be chosen.

appearance: The field has the input background and border of a text field, with a small avatar before the name. Rows show a medium avatar, the name in the default text colour, the description and hint in the muted colour, and an accent-strong check mark when chosen. Dark and high-contrast themes resolve the same roles.
platformNotes: The web opens a popover under a trigger; on iPhone the list opens in a sheet with the system search field, the pattern of Mail and Contacts pickers. The web's custom trigger, renderOption, renderValue, footer and sm/md/lg sizes are not offered: rows are fixed avatar rows with 44-point targets, and a footer action belongs in the screen or the sheet's toolbar. Search is an async closure cancelled through Swift task cancellation instead of an AbortSignal. Android uses the same name and a bottom sheet. Several closures are optional (search, onCreate). Pass each one with its label: Swift gives a single unlabelled trailing closure to the first parameter that accepts it, which is search.
accessibility: The field is one button labelled with the field's label; its value is every chosen name joined with commas, or "None".
The hint reads the error ("Error: …"), the help text and "Required", each when present; a new error is announced.
Avatars are decorative, because the name is written beside them.
The clear button is a separate button named "Clear".
Each row is a button read with its name, description and hint; chosen rows have the selected trait and a check mark.
Rows, the field and the clear button are at least 44 points high.
edgeCases: A chosen id that is in neither entities nor selectedEntities, and was not picked in this session, shows the raw id.
An answer that arrives after the text changed is dropped, because the task that asked for it was cancelled.
Long names wrap in the field and in the rows.
Picking a chosen row in the multiple form removes it.

examples.title: Project with groups, clear option and footer
examples.webExample: Project with groups, clear option and footer
examples.code:
VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
    MonarchEntityPicker(
        "Project",
        selection: $project,
        entities: [
            MonarchEntityPickerEntity(id: "website", name: "Website refresh", hint: "WEB", systemImage: "rectangle.3.group", shape: .square, group: "Active"),
            MonarchEntityPickerEntity(id: "mobile", name: "Mobile onboarding", hint: "MOB", systemImage: "list.bullet", shape: .square, group: "Active"),
            MonarchEntityPickerEntity(id: "billing", name: "Billing migration", hint: "BIL", systemImage: "square.grid.2x2", shape: .square, group: "Active"),
            MonarchEntityPickerEntity(id: "research", name: "Customer research", description: "Paused until next quarter", hint: "RES", systemImage: "list.bullet", shape: .square, group: "Paused"),
        ],
        prompt: "Choose a project",
        clearOptionTitle: "No project",
        footerTitle: "Manage projects"
    )
}
